scope: Paired decider queries on 12 captured live Deity Russia Religious-target boards (2026-11-10), each cut at the first state frame of the turn on which the live game's journal read "Declaring war on <rival> to deny the space race". Both arms run one frozen `civvis_orders --explain --resumed` built from the branch with the run's own requested genome; the on arm adds `--with religion-seat-spares-the-launcher`. All 12 pairs completed. The off arm proposes a war declaration on 10 boards and the on arm on none; the proposed orders differ on 11. This records proposal activation on captured live input only; it does not execute in Civ VI and makes no strength claim.
